svg.aria-label: Architecture: the gatherer fetches every desk's data before any desk starts; eight specialist agents are each handed their share and answer in one model call, three at a time; the orchestrator combines a deterministic weighted score with an LLM memo and live catalysts into one verdict, persisted to SQLite and JSON.
